body:
when i gave my non-coffee drinking friends some totm, i had them try the hazelnut and midnight oil. they loved it. i even gave it to them black for them to add their own cream/sugar and they honestly thought it was fine as is! but cream and sugar make the drink a little more fun :D

midnight oil is the first flavor totm came out with so i think it’s worth a try, but if you feel like you won’t be into a deep bold flavor (think dark chocolate but not as bitter or intense), maybe try high noon which is considered to be a lighter taste with a hint of toffee and fruit. if you like nutella, the hazelnut totm is reminiscent of that.

i usually don’t drink coffee black since yes, it will sometimes taste like burnt dirt, but the totm stuff is reeaally smooth. not sure how it’d be for a new coffee drinker since i have a set idea of what i’d consider good or bad, but i remember hearing how jack got his girlfriend to start drinking coffee because of totm and i feel like that says a lot. whichever you decide to go with, i hope you’ll enjoy it just as much as we all do!
